summary: TerraTech is a smart agricultural Decision Support Tool that combines real-time IoT field telemetry from ESP32 sensors with NASA data to optimize crop rotation, soil degradation, and water efficiency.
details:
TerraTech: Smart Crop Rotation for Lampung, Indonesia

Lampung, at the southern tip of Sumatra, is one of Indonesia’s key agricultural provinces, producing crops such as eggplant, lettuce, sweet corns, etc. It is also a region where farmers face increasingly erratic rainfall, alternating between prolonged dry spells and waterlogging. Many rely on repeated monocropping of cassava and maize, which depletes soil nutrients and structure over time. We chose Lampung because climate variability and soil degradation directly threaten smallholder livelihoods and national food security.

TerraTech is a smart agricultural Decision Support System (DSS) that combines real-time IoT field telemetry with satellite climate data to optimize crop rotation, predicts soil degradation, and reads soil moisture. An ESP32 microcontroller with a capacitive soil-moisture sensor and a DHT22 air temperature and humidity sensor sends live field readings to a Node.js web app. NASA MERRA-2 parameters (soil wetness, rainfall, and temperature) provide the regional baseline, from which we derive Consecutive Dry Days (CDD) and Consecutive Wet Days (CWD) to signal drought and waterlogging risk.

A rule-based rotation algorithm combines the last crop planted, the farmer’s priorities, sensor readings, and climate indices to recommend a multi-stage crop sequence, with a clear explanation for each suggestion. A Tailwind CSS dashboard shows live telemetry, trends, a field-health score, and offline alerts.

TerraTech’s concept, design, hardware, and decisions are our team’s own. We used AI as an assistant: Claude Opus helped generate parts of the code (backend, dashboard, ESP32 firmware), Gemini helped edit our video presentation, and Claude helped draft our written documentation. We reviewed and tested all AI-assisted output, and all climate data comes from NASA MERRA-2.

By pairing satellite-scale context with field-level truth, TerraTech turns Earth observation data into practical, affordable decisions for farmers.
